title: Lifts (Mitsubishi) – Shaft & Landings
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Shaft walls at least 140 mm thick (or to suit landing components) with no cavities?
Safety screening in place for any gaps over 150 mm?
400 V supply to the top of the shaft, separator screens installed?
Ask the fitter: What shadow gap does the landing architrave need? Could they answer?
questions.source: SuperPrime site practice – a fitter who can't answer is a red flag

questions.q: Landing push cut-outs at the dimensions on the lift drawing (wall to centre of plate)?
1500 × 1500 mm clear in front of each lift entrance, including wall finish?
Opening nibs within +25 mm / −0 of the lift drawing; heads level?
Landing sills at least 25 mm above the finished floor?
Guide rails plumb, brackets tight and pinned at the top?
Pit dry and clean, sump covered, pit ladder fixed?
Storage area at least 10 m² next to the shaft, dry and tidy?
questions.source: Mitsubishi lift ITP 66001 – builders work checklist

questions.q: Landing doors in line when closed, even gaps around and under the doors?
questions.source: Mitsubishi lift ITP 66001 – landing door checks

guide.title: Lift landings – SJWS limits
rows: 10 mm (Field issue – backing board routed back)
at least 25 mm above finished floor
Clear space in front of lift
in line closed, even gaps, aligned with jambs open

questions.q: Doors line up with the jambs when open; architraves and sills undamaged?
questions.source: Mitsubishi lift ITP 66001 – landing door checks

questions.q: Landing push plates fitted level at the set-out position; car finishes protected?
questions.source: Mitsubishi lift ITP 66001 – landing push cut-outs

notOk.t: Landing architrave clashing with the 10 mm shadow gap
Pit / shaft painting incomplete; shaft not cleaned
SWA / glands not terminated or earthed correctly
Indicator upside down, COP misaligned, pictograms bent
Visible welds or scratches in the car

ask.q: What clear space is needed in front of each entrance?
What tolerance on the opening nibs?
ask.a: +25 mm / −0 of the lift drawing, heads level.

ask.q: How high are the landing sills above finished floor?
